input_file.description: Path to the input OSM data file (e.g., planet.pbf or filtered osm)

output_db.description: Path to the output Spatialite database file

srs.description: EPSG code for the spatial reference system (4326 for WGS84, 3857 for Mercator)

gdal_driver.description: GDAL driver to use for output (SQLite, GPKG, ESRI Shapefile)

output_polygons.description: Which polygons to write: land, water, both, or none

output_lines.description: If true, output coastlines as lines to the database

output_rings.description: If true, output rings to the database (for debugging)

bbox_overlap.description: Overlap distance in projection units for splitting large polygons

close_distance.description: Distance to close gaps in coastline data; 0 to disable

max_points.description: Maximum number of points per polygon/linestring; 0 to disable splitting

no_index.description: If true, do not create spatial indexes in the output database

overwrite.description: If true, overwrite the output file if it already exists

exit_ignore_warnings.description: If true, return exit code 0 even if there are warnings

verbose.description: If true, give detailed information on what osmcoastline is doing

write_segments.description: Filename to write all coastline segments to; empty string to disable
